profiles.static: Repository contracts that need neither Docker nor running TerraSys services.
profiles.browser: Static contracts, service health, and all browser regressions.
profiles.full: Static contracts, service health, API/data lifecycle, and all browser regressions.
profiles.recovery: The full profile followed by the isolated offline-recovery drill.

cases.title: Repository configuration and test catalog remain parseable
cases.risk: A malformed catalog or configuration makes builds and maintenance behavior ambiguous.
assertions: Tracked JSON configuration parses successfully.
Test identifiers are unique and every automation path exists.
Every browser smoke script and its support data are copied into the UI-test image.
cases.evidence: Console summary from the static repository-contract run.

cases.title: PowerShell entry points remain syntactically valid
cases.risk: A parse error can block startup, maintenance, backup, or recovery before runtime checks begin.
assertions: Every tracked PowerShell script parses without syntax errors.
cases.evidence: PowerShell parser count in the static test summary.

cases.title: Digest-only Nominatim image recovery remains immutable
cases.risk: Docker save/load can omit repository metadata and cause an offline restore to attempt an unavailable registry pull.
assertions: Startup recognizes the approved local SHA256 image ID when repository digests are absent.
The immutable ID remains accepted by shared-index rebuilds and offline image export while mismatched references are rejected.
Downloaded Kiwix archives and manifests are readable by non-owner container users on Linux.
cases.evidence: Nominatim image-reference assertions in the static repository-contract run.

cases.title: Linux public bind mounts remain container-readable
cases.risk: A restrictive host umask can make web, map-pack, or knowledge assets return 403 inside non-owner containers.
assertions: Startup normalizes owner-controlled files under only the three public bind roots.
Startup flattens recursive directory enumeration before validating each Unix file mode.
Startup rejects any remaining file or directory that lacks the required other-read or traversal permission.
The dedicated OSM Carto Apache worker shares renderd's identity so newly rendered owner-only cache directories remain readable.
cases.evidence: Public bind-mount permission assertions in the static repository-contract run.

cases.title: Maintained documentation keeps English and Chinese pairs
cases.risk: Operational changes can silently leave one language with stale or missing instructions.
assertions: Each maintained Markdown document has its .zh-CN.md or English counterpart.
Each document links to its language counterpart.
cases.evidence: Bilingual-pair count in the static test summary.

cases.title: Local Markdown links resolve inside the repository
cases.risk: Moved or renamed runbooks can leave recovery and operations instructions unusable.
assertions: Every relative Markdown file link resolves to an existing repository path.
cases.evidence: Local-link count in the static test summary.

cases.title: Local service stack and installed products are healthy
cases.risk: A nominally running stack can still have broken PMTiles ranges, stale resources, or unavailable engines.
assertions: Compose services, nginx, API, PostGIS, Martin, installed PMTiles range requests, resource inventory, weather, routing, elevation, and knowledge services pass their health contracts.

cases.title: Regional and global package catalogs preserve lifecycle metadata
cases.risk: New regions can appear installable while boundaries, source ownership, details, or recovery metadata are incomplete.
assertions: The 34 province units, global provider catalog, and bounded source overrides are complete.
North/South Korea direct sources are fully validated and recorded by SHA256 when no upstream state file exists.
Installed packages verify through the maintenance queue.
Package manifests expose source, rich-detail, checksum, and recovery metadata.
Protected removal is rejected without its confirmation token.
cases.evidence: Functional smoke-test completion output and maintenance verification results.

cases.title: Derived resources match every enabled installed region
cases.risk: A newly installed region can be present in PMTiles but absent from Carto, search, routing, elevation, weather, or nautical products.
assertions: Resource inventory and update checks cover all enabled packages.
Per-region source provenance and freshness are shown for shared and derived resources.
The resource console exposes real, non-destructive management actions and worker state.
cases.evidence: Functional smoke output plus resource-console screenshot.

cases.title: Personal places, tracks, collections, search, and version conflicts work end to end
cases.risk: Schema or API changes can lose edits, bypass optimistic concurrency, or leave temporary data behind.
assertions: Temporary places, tracks, and collections can be created, queried, updated, assigned, and deleted.
Version conflicts are rejected and database counts return to their starting values.
cases.evidence: Functional smoke output; cleanup always runs from the script finally block.

cases.title: Imports, exports, and media ownership remain recoverable
cases.risk: Exports can omit records or media, while deletion can leave orphaned ownership metadata.
assertions: GPX import, GeoJSON export, per-track and full GPX export, and personal ZIP export are valid.
Linked media follows place and track ownership and is removed without orphans.
cases.evidence: Functional smoke output and validated temporary export archive.

cases.title: Keyless additional information adapters remain normalized and bounded
cases.risk: Provider differences, cache regressions, or AIS decoding errors can break overlays or leak into the main map.
assertions: The runtime catalog stays no-key-only and declares all P0/P1 overlays.
TTL caching, persistent enable/refresh settings, runtime health, antimeridian bounds, normalized USGS GeoJSON, and open AIS NMEA position decoding pass deterministic unit tests.
The additional-layer entry mounts a selected source while contours remain available in the ordinary layer panel.
The standalone console exposes all nine no-key sources and five keyed candidates, and its setting/test controls use their bounded APIs.
cases.evidence: Python unit output plus runtime/ui-smoke and runtime/information-layer-console-smoke screenshots.

cases.title: Main map workflow, details, editing, and responsive layout remain usable
cases.risk: Map, panel, accessibility, and tool-control changes can regress together without API failures.
assertions: TerraSys branding, collapsed-sidebar accessibility, local Carto rendering, PMTiles details, collections, offline search, edit mode, contours, legend, attribution, and narrow layout pass.
Runtime console and network failures contain no unexpected errors.
cases.evidence: Playwright console output and runtime/ui-smoke screenshots.

cases.title: Resource console keeps catalog, lifecycle, and task state visible
cases.risk: Catalog growth or task updates can overflow the layout or replace the resource-browsing workspace.
assertions: Installed rows match the API, the global hierarchy and search work, and source/version details are visible.
Storage, update, worker, action, and persistent task-rail layouts do not overflow.

cases.title: Map source selection and offline fallback remain deterministic
cases.risk: Provider failures, Carto lag, or map movement can produce blank maps or misleading coverage state.
assertions: Local Carto, OSM Standard, OpenFreeMap, regional PMTiles, and the world overview switch without rebuilding the full style.
Provider failure and Carto synchronization states retain the correct fallback.
Viewport/polygon coverage avoids coastal, ocean, antimeridian, and low-zoom false prompts.
cases.evidence: Playwright output and targeted world-map screenshots.

cases.title: Global package prompts and Chinese place labels stay normalized
cases.risk: Global source data can leak inconsistent country names into prompts, labels, and resource names.
assertions: Japan, United States, and Taiwan package prompts resolve through precise country polygons.
Taiwan is displayed as 台湾省 in package prompts, resource names, feature details, and all global overview label layers.

cases.title: Main-map startup stays inside the saved performance envelope
cases.risk: Duplicate inventory requests or synchronous catalog work can materially slow first interaction.
assertions: The map-pack inventory is requested once during startup.
DOMContentLoaded, map canvas, and system-ready milestones stay below wide saved guardrails.
Current timings are reported against the retained three-run median.
cases.evidence: Structured performance JSON including baseline deltas.

cases.title: Backup and offline-kit manifests reject missing, unsafe, or modified payloads
cases.risk: A recovery package can look complete while containing unsafe paths, size drift, or checksum failures.
assertions: Manifest paths stay inside the selected kit and every required payload matches its recorded size and SHA256.

cases.title: A complete offline kit restores on an isolated Docker network
cases.risk: Backups may be individually valid but fail to restore a usable disconnected system.
assertions: Database migrations, personal counts, media, PMTiles, Martin, Nominatim, Valhalla, elevation, Kiwix, nginx, and exports work without external network access.
Temporary recovery containers, volumes, and network are removed after the drill.
